## Threads and the GVL

MRI Ruby has a Global VM Lock — CPU-bound threads don't run truly in parallel. Threads still help for IO-bound work (releases GVL on blocking IO).

## Fibers and Async

Fibers are cooperative coroutines. The `async` gem builds structured concurrency on fibers for high-concurrency IO.

## Ractors

Ractors isolate memory for parallel CPU work with message passing. API is stricter; share only immutable/deep-copied data. For multi-core CPU, also consider multiple processes.
